newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ARANYPOK SAYS 1996 FIGURES ARE ABOVE PLANS.
newsitem.headline: ARANYPOK SAYS 1996 FIGURES ARE ABOVE PLANS.

text.p: Hungarian clothes retailer Aranypok Kereskedelmi Rt said on Wednesday that its 1996 sales revenues and profits were above not only the previous year's figures but were also above the plans.

"The 27.4 percent increase in sales revenues in 1996 over the previous year should be regarded as positive," Aranypok's General Director Andras Bartha said in the company's earnings report. "The plan was surpassed by 11.8 percent."
Aranypok said its sales revenues rose to 1.72 billion forints in 1996 from 1.35 billion in 1995 and were above the plan of 1.54 billion.
"Sales revenues proved that the company boosted its market share," Bartha said. "This is underpinned by the fact that, unlike in previous year, the number of our clients grew."
Aranypok said it posted an after-tax profit of 61.9 million, surpassing 42.9 million in 1995 and 51.3 million planned for 1996.
